plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Add to QQQI, targeting 25%, to favor income and broad index exposure.
Trim CRWD to 10% to cap single name exposure.
Buy DDOG, a top-quality scanner setup, for 5% of the book.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5%/month. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by eliminating leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest returns.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 1% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Trim QQQI to 15% to slightly reduce income focus.
Buy DDOG for 4% and ZS for 4% to add quality tech setups from the scanner.
This plan balances broad index, quality tech, and a small amount of leverage.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month with a risk-first growth approach. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, aiming for consistent growth.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.
Trim QQQI to 10% to reduce income focus and free up capital.
Add to SOXL, targeting 6%, and SPAL, targeting 6%, to increase leveraged ETF exposure.
Buy DDOG for 6% and ZS for 6% to concentrate in high-scoring scanner setups.
This plan leans into leverage and concentration for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets ~4%/month by stretching into leverage and concentrating in high-scoring setups. Be aware that this significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this approach can lose a lot fast; strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETFs.
Sell CRWD to zero to remove high-beta single name exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30%, to prioritize income and broad index exposure.
This plan focuses on steady monthly distributions with low drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month by rotating into income-focused ETFs and broad index. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth. Remember, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is cash-like income, not a savings account.
